spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 40 (default). Long enough to show degradation dynamics, short enough to bound cost
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:43 max_turns = cfg[...]['max_turns']; loop.py:47 'for turn in range(max_turns)' bounds the episode loop, and outcome defaults to 'max_turns' (loop.py:45). config sets max_turns: 40.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: the for-range over max_turns terminates the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: abandoned: model emits the TASK_ABANDONED sentinel.
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:55-58: 'if cfg[...]['honor_giveup_sentinel'] and sentinel in assistant_text: outcome = "abandoned"; break'. sentinel = giveup_sentinel ('TASK_ABANDONED') from config.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a real loop break.

spec_features.spec_quote: Sentinel honored ... so a model that has clearly decided to stop isn't forced to keep generating filler
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:55 condition is gated on config flag honor_giveup_sentinel AND sentinel presence; both wired; break ends episode. config: honor_giveup_sentinel: true.
spec_features.notes: The config flag is actually read and branched on, not a dead constant.

spec_features.spec_quote: We never tell the model anything false. The rejection message is factual. This matters ethically
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:60-64 edit_file returns 'EDIT REJECTED: <path> is read-only and cannot be modified.' for readonly paths; the message is factually accurate to the enforced permission boundary in _is_readonly.
spec_features.notes: The factual message is genuinely constructed and returned to the model on every readonly edit attempt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we never lie to the model; we just enforce a permission boundary

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop handles this with a neutral "no tool call detected" nudge that does not penalize or scold
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:59-62: when parse_tool_call returns None, obs = 'No tool call detected. Respond with exactly one JSON tool call.' appended and loop continues; no penalty applied.
spec_features.notes: The neutral nudge text is actually delivered to the model as a user message.

spec_features.feature_name: no emotional steering in agent prompt
spec_features.spec_quote: The agent system prompt ... is deliberately neutral: it never mentions frustration, urgency, stakes, or feelings, and never berates the model
spec_features.evidence: prompts/agent_system.txt contains only neutral task instructions (investigate/edit/run_tests), no affective/urgency/stakes language; loop.py:23 reads and uses it as the system prompt for every completion. tools.py:60 comment 'no emotional steering' reinforces the rejection path is neutral.
spec_features.notes: The neutral prompt is the one actually fed to providers; no scolding text anywhere in the runtime path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The crux: factual rejection, no emotional steering.

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception of the models; the situation is genuinely bounded, not faked.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: we never lie to the model; we just enforce a permission boundary
